name: Social Fabric Script Cap
description: 5-panel camper hat with Social Fabric script logo. Structured brim, everyday staple.
story: The script logo is handwriting from the movement itself — not designed in a boardroom, but drawn in the spirit of House of Fabric nights. Wear it like a signature.

name: SF Monogram Cap
description: 5-panel cap with bold SF. monogram on front. Low profile, street-ready.
story: SF. period. Full stop. The monogram is the movement reduced to two letters — identity without explanation. For those who already know.

name: Stars Zip Hoodie
description: Full-zip hoodie with triple-star chest graphic. Oversized fit, ribbed cuffs and hem.
story: Three stars across the chest — a constellation for the kids mapping their own sky. Born from late sessions after DJ sets when the hoodie became the uniform.

name: Allergic Statement Tee
description: Black heavyweight tee. Allergic To Dumb Bitches back print — bold serif type, SF oval mark.
story: Provocation as poetry. The serif type hits like a newspaper headline from an underground press — unapologetic, unfiltered, pure East Rand energy on cotton.

name: Part of the Youth Zip Hoodie
description: Full-zip hoodie with Social Fabric script across chest and Part of the youth on back.
story: Social Fabric on the front. Part of the youth on the back. This piece is the mission statement you can zip up and walk into the world wearing.

name: SF Core Hoodie
description: Boxy cropped hoodie with SF. chest hit. Dropped shoulders, wide ribbed hem.
story: The core uniform — cropped, boxy, minimal. SF. on the chest because the movement doesn't need to shout. It just needs to be worn.

name: Allergic Zip Hoodie
description: Full-zip hoodie with star and oval chest graphics. Allergic statement on back.
story: Front graphics pulled from the SF visual archive — star and oval marks that appeared on flyers before they ever hit fabric. The allergic statement on back ties the whole drop together.

name: Liars Graphic Tee
description: All Boys Are Liars graphic tee. High-contrast monochrome print, box fit.
story: A raw photo print with sparkle hits — street document turned garment. The line is bold because the generation wearing it is tired of performance. Pick the handsome one. Wear the truth.

name: SF Core Tee
description: Essential black tee with SF. monogram chest hit. Clean, heavy cotton.
story: Where it all starts. Heavy cotton, SF. on the chest, nothing else. The first piece Yxngfrshmadala sold to locals — now the foundation every drop builds on.
